en: Pay by mobile money or bank at checkout, even with no internet
Type the quantity in the cart, and no selling past the stock
Home shows stock value at cost and the profit you can expect
Choose the supplier when you restock
sw: Lipa kwa pesa ya simu au benki unapokamilisha mauzo, hata bila intaneti
Andika idadi kwenye kikapu, na huwezi kuuza zaidi ya stoki
Nyumbani inaonyesha thamani ya stoki kwa bei ya kununua na faida tarajiwa
